scope: Source-backed evidence observed during the 36 months ending on each completed leadership-transition announcement date.
warningDefinition: An official issuer announcement that cuts earnings guidance or quantifies a material prospective adverse impact on profit. Trading softness without a quantified profit implication is excluded.
dissentDefinition: A management-sponsored resolution receiving at least 20% votes against. Shareholder proposals and withheld votes are excluded.

warningEvents.summary: Shell expected post-tax impairments of $15-22 billion after revising its medium- and long-term price and margin outlook.
Vodafone narrowed adjusted EBITDAaL guidance to the bottom of its prior range and reduced adjusted free-cash-flow guidance.
Rolls-Royce expected full-year underlying operating profit and free cash flow toward the lower end of guidance ranges.
Whitbread quantified the acute prospective profitability impact of COVID-19 closures and RevPAR deterioration in its full-year results.
Burberry warned that the slowdown in luxury demand was affecting current trading and could reduce full-year operating profit.
Burberry reduced its adjusted operating-profit expectation after continued demand weakness.
Burberry warned of an operating loss for the first half and suspended its dividend after a sharp trading deterioration.
Rentokil reduced North America organic growth expectations and warned that group adjusted operating profit would be below prior expectations.
Diageo expected materially weaker first-half organic operating-profit growth because of deterioration in Latin America and Caribbean trading.
